image_description: A close-up view of a vertical traffic light assembly mounted on a dark pole. The housing is yellow/gold metal with three circular signal sections. The top section displays a red standing figure (pedestrian stop), the middle is unlit/dark, and the bottom displays a green walking figure (pedestrian go). To the left, a portion of a secondary signal head is visible. The background consists of bare tree branches and a stone structure, indicating an urban outdoor setting in winter or late autumn.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The three circular sections are the dominant feature of the front face, consistent with standard traffic light proportions.
